column1: # [claude-9b-think] 2026-10-27 The keyboard-and-mouse wording of the game's texts by string key
# (game/button_prompts.cpp, LoadPromptText). Our own words only, never the game's.
# A row: KEY<tab>TEXT.
#  KEY   the string's key: its hash as 8 hex digits (the game's own key hash, h * 33 + each lowercase
#        character; dev/agents/button-prompts/HINTS-CATALOG.tsv lists every hint's), or a key name.
#  TEXT  shown instead while the keyboard and mouse are in use (menus and play), English only. It may
#        use the game's [ACTION] words and ~button tokens, and these: <MOVE> the movement keys, <LOOK>
#        the mouse (the look keys without mouse aim), <BIND:keybind_x> the key of a controller button's
#        bind, <ACTION:name> the key of one of the port's actions (game/keybinds/binds.h), <KEY:name> a
#        key; \n a new line.
# userdata/prompt_text_kbm.tsv, if there, is read after this file at start: its rows add to these or
# replace them. Texts without a row keep the stick phrase table (button_prompts.cpp kStickPhrases).
# Saint-Lo: moving and looking around (both sticks in words; two wordings).

column2: Use <MOVE> to move and <LOOK> to look around.
